title.narrative: Public procurement contracts awarded using the Recipient's e-procurement system

comment.narrative: The APPEL platform, the national e-procurement solution, was launched on October 14, 2025; with 57 contracting authorities on boarded, 38 public procurement plans published, 385 suppliers registered and six electronic ongoing tenders in process. To further advance the achievement, the AutoritE de REgulation de la Commande Publique-ARCOP/ Public Procurement Regulatory Authority will continue to intensify implementation efforts, with key actions including the finalization and publication of the pilot phase completion report on ARCOP's website, alongside measures to further expand and institutionalize the use of the e-procurement solution among contracting authorities.
